mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds rate above 4% in the month prior to the decision is associated with a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to higher discounting of future cash flows.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4% in the prior month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are non-negative in at least 70% of similar FEDFUNDS > 4% trigger events, or IC > 0.05 over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment claims (PAYEMS) followed by a subsequent decline are interpreted as a labor market softening that precedes a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS shows a double bottom pattern (increase then decrease) over the prior 3 months
regime_hint: early stage of labor market weakening
failure_condition: No significant positive return in 80% of similar labor weakening double-bottom events (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in home sales (HOUST) exceeding 5% from the prior month predicts a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as it signals resilient consumer demand.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative in >50% of such HOUST > +5% events (t-test).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) of more than 2% for three consecutive months predicts a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return as it indicates supply-side contraction.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO monthly change < -2% for three consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day returns are non-negative in >60% of such INDPRO contractions (IC > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) unexpectedly rises by more than 0.5% in a month, the S&P 500 shows a negative 5-day forward return due to immediate market uncertainty.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are positive in >80% of similar CPIAUCSL surprise events (p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in unemployment (UNRATE) and a decline in manufacturing payrolls (not available, so use RSAFS as proxy for payrolls) suggests labor market weakness and a positive 60-day S&P 500 return.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE increases while RSAFS decreases over the prior 2 months
failure_condition: No significant positive return in 70% of such dual-move events (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in retail sales proxy (use GDPC1 as proxy for broad demand) for two consecutive months predicts a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to deflationary expectations.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 monthly change < -2% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day returns are non-negative in >50% of such GDPC1 declines (IC > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) and home sales (HOUST) both show double tops over the prior 6 months, the S&P 500 exhibits a positive 60-day forward return as a recovery signal.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO and HOUST each form a double top pattern over prior 6 months
regime_hint: dual softening then stabilization in supply and demand
failure_condition: 60-day returns are negative in >75% of such interaction events (p < 0.01).
